treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Republic of Poland for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2002, as amended 2020)
eif_quote: De bepalingen van het Verdrag en het Protocol zijn ingevolge artikel 32, tweede lid, van het Verdrag en de preambule tot het Protocol op 18 maart 2003 in werking getreden.
source_title: wetten.overheid.nl consolidated text BWBV0001578 (English authentic text, prevailing; Trb. 2002, 86 as amended by Protocol of 29-10-2020, Trb. 2020, 119)

rates.quote: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed: c) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed: b) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, the royalties referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Arts. 10, 11 and 29 as amended by the Amending Protocol of 29-10-2020 (Trb. 2020, 119), in force 2022-04-30 (Trb. 2022, 23); its Art. 28: provisions have effect for taxable years and periods beginning, and taxable events occurring, on or after 1 January of the calendar year following entry into force -> 2023-01-01. Royalties Art. 12 unchanged since the 2002 Convention: Art. 32(2)(a) withholding taxes on income derived on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2003-03-18) -> 2004-01-01. Not modelled: dividends 0% for recognised tax-exempt pension funds (Art. 10(2)(a)); Protocol: Art. 10(2)(b) 5% rate does not apply to dividends paid by or to a Dutch FBI or a Polish exempt open-ended investment fund; interest exempt at source (Art. 11(3)) for export-promotion loans, sales on credit of equipment, loans granted by a bank (incl. convertible bonds per Protocol), government bonds, payments to the State, recognised pension funds, and (Protocol) FMO etc. Treaty PPT in Art. 29 (2020 Protocol); MLI not applicable since only Poland lists the treaty (treaties_merged.json).
